name: RevealButton
description: A button that opens an arrow beside its label when you hover or focus it, to suggest "go". Only a transition, so there is nothing to pause. Builds on Button.

children.description: Button label. Icon-only buttons must pass aria-label instead.

size.description: Height, padding and font size, as on Button.

isDisabled.description: Prevents interaction and dims the button.

isLoading.description: Shows a spinner and blocks presses; the pending state is announced.

onPress.description: Called when the button is pressed by mouse, touch or keyboard.

requirements: Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and the effect can also be shown still with the rdm-still class
The arrow appears on keyboard focus as well as hover, and is decorative
The transition is switched off for reduced motion, leaving the arrow in its final state only on hover or focus
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
screenReader: Announced exactly as a Button: its label, as a button; the effect adds nothing to what is read

use_when: Buttons that lead somewhere: Read more, Continue, View all
anti_patterns: Relying on the arrow alone to say where it goes
